verdict.rationale: Replit documents a design space where you can tweak designs visually and apply them to your app. Agent can also turn a selected Replit Design frame into a functional website while preserving its visual design. That covers the design-to-implementation half of the story, but only for designs made inside Replit; nothing shows importing a Figma file or other external design. Missing for 10: Figma file import, import of existing external designs or screenshots, independent or hands-on corroboration of design fidelity.
